intro.text: Your family is packing a go bag. Let's help!

hint.text: Think of what you need for 3 days.

lesson.text: Pack a go bag before an earthquake. It should last 3 days and be easy to reach.

choices.label: Pack it later, when it shakes
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Get it ready now. Keep it where you can grab it.

choices.label: Hide it under the boxes
choices.feedback: Keep your go bag in a place that is easy to find.

choices.label: Pack water, food, a flashlight and a whistle
choices.feedback: These help your family for 3 days. Keep the bag easy to reach.

choices.label: Pack only snacks and toys
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: A go bag needs water, food and a light for 3 days.
